solves.reason: ② valuing should be valued. 'why Americans valued meat' needs past tense verb, not present participle

④ emerged should be emerging. 'emerging technologies'=currently rising. emerged=already happened, wrong nuance
③ distrust is wrong; original is trust. 'don't distrust'=double negative=trust, contradicting the passage's meaning of not trusting
② ingredients is wrong; original is alternatives. meat alternatives(대안), not meat ingredients(재료)
T. 'investigating why Americans valued meat so much' + 'As part of the project'
F. 'most consumers didn't know how to sort plant-based milks' - couldn't classify easily
F. 'will likely be similar to' not different from. The reaction will be similar to GMO negative reactions
'literacy' - gaps in literacy of emerging technologies
'successful implementation' - gaps hinder the successful implementation of products
